findings.claim: `--_fs-base` was retyped from `<length>` to `*`. This global change has nothing to do with the Legend work, and it removes the type check and the 1rem fallback that every `--fs-*` token depends on.
findings.evidence: The diff changes `@property --_fs-base { syntax: "<length>"` to `syntax: "*"`. Every token from `--fs-2xs` to `--fs-6xl` is built as `calc(var(--_fs-base) * pow(...))` (variables.css:76-86). With the `<length>` type, a non-length override such as `--_fs-base: 16` or `large` was rejected and the 1rem initial value was kept. With `*` the value is substituted as written, so the `calc` is invalid wherever it is used. Relative overrides such as `em` are also no longer resolved once at the root; they pass down as unresolved text. No Legend file reads `--_fs-base`.
